title: YesStyle on Trustpilot: score, complaints and what the numbers show
seoTitle: YesStyle Trustpilot reviews: score and complaints
description: YesStyle scores 4.4 on Trustpilot, with over 104,000 reviews and 71% five-star. See the delivery complaints and why a global score says nothing about your own country.
metaDescription: YesStyle on Trustpilot on October 28, 2026: 4.4 from 104,000 reviews, 71% five-star, delivery and tracking complaints. See what the score doesn't show.
imageAlt: Cecília holding the open jar of Abib eye patches, with the YesStyle logo and the Trustpilot score of 4.4 out of 5

contentSections.heading: Quick answer
paragraphs: YesStyle has a good Trustpilot score, with one caveat. On October 28, 2026, the TrustScore was 4.4, with more than 104,000 reviews and 71% five-star; complaints concentrate on international delivery and tracking. The score is global and doesn't separate countries.

contentSections.heading: What the score measures
paragraphs: The TrustScore is the profile's Trustpilot score. YesStyle had 4.4, labeled “Excellent”, across 104,552 reviews; 11,757 of them were published in the last 12 months. The profile is claimed by the company and has a paid Trustpilot subscription, as the page itself states.

The breakdown by star, from the same reading: 71% five-star, 18% four-star, 3% three-star, 1% two-star and 7% one-star. Five and four stars make up most of the total; the one-star share, at 7%, weighs more than two and three stars combined, and that is where the complaints show up.

image.alt: Bars from five stars to one showing the distribution of YesStyle's Trustpilot reviews: 71%, 18%, 3%, 1% and 7%
image.caption: Distribution of YesStyle's Trustpilot reviews. Chart by us.

postParagraphs: The average sums all this up in a single number. To decide, it's worth more to look at what the low scores say and how the store replies to them; that's what comes next.

contentSections.heading: Who reviews, and from where
paragraphs: The profile for www.yesstyle.com is global: it doesn't separate reviews by country, and the page doesn't say how many came from each country. The score brings together buyers from different countries, with different shipping, delivery times and customs.

For anyone buying, this changes how to read it: the score tells you how the store behaves overall, not what delivery is like at your address. That information is in the checkout and in the store's shipping table, not on Trustpilot.
Who operates the store, the Hong Kong headquarters and the parent company are covered in [Is YesStyle legit?](/en/reviews/is-yesstyle-legit-and-safe-review).

contentSections.heading: What shows up in the complaints
paragraphs: The complaints revolve around international delivery. We read the visible negative reviews and noted the themes, without counting or ranking them:
bullets: Late delivery and long waits, on a package coming from abroad.
Order held in processing, before shipping.

image.alt: Illustration of a tracking screen: package shipped, flight completed, delivery stalled and the house still waiting, next to a receipt with a barcode and a globe
image.caption: Our illustration of stalled tracking, one of the complaint themes. Keep the order number and the tracking code.

postParagraphs: These are the points where an international purchase tends to fail. For the reader, they show where to look: the delivery time at checkout, the tracking after shipping and the packaging on arrival.

contentSections.heading: What shows up in the praise
paragraphs: In the positive reviews, from the same reading, the themes are different:
bullets: A large selection of Korean beauty.
Delivery that sometimes arrives ahead of schedule.
An app and site that are easy to use.
postParagraphs: Praise and complaints talk about different moments of the purchase: praise is about the catalog, the price and the package that arrived; complaints are about the package that was late or never came. The score combines both.

contentSections.heading: What the store replies
paragraphs: The profile says YesStyle replied to 98% of negative reviews, usually within 24 hours, and warns that the reply may use artificial intelligence.

Replying is not solving. We did not read the text of the replies, so this article doesn't say whether they fix the problem for the person who complained. Before buying, it's worth opening a few one-star reviews on the profile and reading the store's reply under each one, especially the ones about tracking and lost packages.

contentSections.heading: What can't be concluded
paragraphs: The score answers one question, not all of them. Four things the reading doesn't support:
bullets: That the score applies to your country: the profile is global and doesn't separate reviews by origin.
That the score measures the product: it combines product, delivery and customer service in a single review, and the complaint themes we read are about delivery and order processing.
That the store resolves complaints: the profile shows the reply rate, 98%, and the reply time; the text of the replies was not read.
What Trustpilot's AI summary says: the page carries a summary generated by artificial intelligence, and this article doesn't use it as a source.

contentSections.heading: Our check
paragraphs: On October 28, 2026, we read YesStyle's public Trustpilot profile, without logging in: the score, the number of reviews, the breakdown by star, the reply rate and the visible reviews, which is where the themes came from.
In the store's app, in a test of ours without a purchase, we checked the checkout: it has the Reward Code field.
Trustpilot's numbers change every month; check the profile on the day you buy.

image.alt: Phone showing YesStyle's Trustpilot profile: 4.4 score, star distribution and 98% of negative reviews answered
image.caption: YesStyle's Trustpilot profile, mobile version. Screenshot of the site, with two sections enlarged.

contentSections.heading: Can you trust YesStyle going by Trustpilot?
paragraphs: By Trustpilot, the reading is good: TrustScore 4.4, “Excellent”, across 104,552 reviews, 71% of them five-star and 7% one-star, with 98% of negative reviews answered, usually within 24 hours.

The caveat is about scope, not score. The profile is global, doesn't separate countries, and the complaints we read are about international delivery: delays, tracking and lost packages. Trustpilot shows how the store behaves overall; the shipping cost and delivery time for your address are in the checkout.

contentSections.heading: Before you pay
paragraphs: The complaints concentrate on delivery, so what you check before paying is the shipping cost and delivery time for your country, which appear in the checkout. The rates and how the delivery time is counted for each country are in [YesStyle's delivery guide](/en/reviews/yesstyle-shipping-us-uk-canada-australia).
After paying, keep the order number and the tracking code: they are what you need to open a ticket with customer service if the package is late or tracking stops.

If you've decided to buy, our page on [YesStyle coupons and the reward code](/en/coupons/yesstyle) leads to the store. The link is an affiliate link: a purchase may earn Em Casa com Cecília a commission, at no extra cost to you.

contentSections.heading: Frequently asked questions
bullets: Does YesStyle have a good Trustpilot score? The TrustScore was 4.4, labeled “Excellent”, across 104,552 reviews; 71% gave five stars and 7% gave one.

What are the most common complaints about YesStyle? In the negative reviews we read, the themes are about international delivery: delays and long waits, stalled tracking, lost packages, damaged items and orders held in processing.
Does YesStyle reply to negative reviews? According to the Trustpilot profile, the store replied to 98% of negative reviews, usually within 24 hours, and the reply may use artificial intelligence.
